review.tagline: Collection of 18 Agent Skills on context and harness engineering for coding agents
review.summary: A set of SKILL.md directories covering context fundamentals, compression, memory, tool design, multi-agent patterns, evaluation and harness design. It installs as a Claude Code plugin marketplace entry, an Open Plugins manifest for Cursor and Codex, or by copying single skill folders into .claude/skills, .cursor/skills or .codex/skills. Six worked examples and a router benchmark are included.
review.audience: Engineers building or tuning coding agents and agent harnesses
strengths: Installs via one /plugin command or by copying individual skill directories
Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other Open Plugins hosts
Skill router benchmarked: 600 calls per sweep across four models, with published results
Includes six worked examples, such as an LLM-as-judge TypeScript implementation with 19 tests
weaknesses: Skills are guidance text; scripts are Python pseudocode, not a runnable library
Router top-1 accuracy ranges 0.84 to 0.92 across tested models
Skill activation depends on the host agent's skill discovery
Some skills are labeled NEW and their maturity is unknown
needs: Needs Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another Agent Skills host
